name: Mulgore
summary: Below the Stonetalon Mountains lies Mulgore, the green and sheltered homeland of the tauren. Grasslands and rolling plains spread between its tall plateaus, and high mountain walls ring it round. It is the heart of the united tribes, and they watch over it from Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Land Reclaimed
sections.body: For generations, the tauren lived as nomads, hunted across the plains by centaur warbands. Their fortune turned when High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof met Thrall and his orcs. They shared ideals of honor, shamanism and strength, so the tauren joined the young Horde. With the orcs' help, Cairne broke the centaur's grip and led his people into Mulgore. Here they built lasting homes for the first time in centuries, and crowned the northern mesas with their capital.

sections.title: The Trials of the Earthmother
sections.body: To come of age in Mulgore, young tauren must answer the call of the Great Hunt and honor the Earthmother. Their training begins at Camp Narache, under Chief Hawkwind. From there they go down to Bloodhoof Village, and take up the Rites of the Earthmother. They learn to speak with the ancestral spirits and to forage the native herbs. And they learn to respect the herds of kodos and tallstriders that sustain their people.

sections.title: Encroaching Shadows
sections.body:
For all its calm, Mulgore is threatened on every side. Displaced quilboar have dug in at Brambleblade Ravine, and they have defiled the sacred burial grounds of Red Rocks. In the mountains, Windfury harpies prey on the wild game, and Palemane gnolls strike from hidden caves.

And outsiders have come to profit from the land. The goblins of the Venture Company are fouling the sacred wells, and quarrying the eastern hills. Dwarven explorers from Bael Modan have opened the Bael'dun Digsite. There they dig for ancient titan relics, over the tauren's protests.

faq.q: Why did the tauren settle permanently in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The tauren settled in Mulgore after joining forces with Thrall's Horde. Centaur marauders had long pursued the nomadic people across Kalimdor, but Cairne Bloodhoof gained the strength to drive them away and reclaim the ancestral valley. The tauren built permanent settlements, including Bloodhoof Village and Thunder Bluff, to give all tribes a unified homeland where they could thrive in peace.

faq.q: How do you leave Mulgore on foot?
aliases: how to get to barrens from mulgore
faq.answer: You can leave Mulgore on foot through the single pass in its southeastern mountain wall. Follow the main dirt highway east past Bloodhoof Village and Morin Cloudstalker's post, through the mountain corridor and into the arid plains of the Barrens.

faq.q: Who are the Venture Company and why are they here?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is a goblin-run commercial cartel seeking Kalimdor's natural riches. In Mulgore, it mines in the eastern mountains and has occupied the vital Thunderhorn, Wildmane, and Winterhoof water wells, defiling the land and threatening the regional water supply.

faq.q: Why are dwarves digging in tauren territory?
faq.answer: Dwarves from the Bael Modan expedition dig at the Bael'dun Digsite in Mulgore's western foothills. The Explorers' League sent them to unearth relics of their Titan creators. They excavate tauren land without permission, despite protests that their work scars the Earthmother.

faq.q: What are the Rites of the Earthmother?
faq.answer: The Rites of the Earthmother are sacred trials that young tauren undertake upon reaching adulthood. They test hunting, tracking, vision communion, and knowledge of the natural balance, proving the initiate's devotion to the land and ancestral traditions. The rites take place in Bloodhoof Village and the Golden Plains.

aliases: who is the chief of mulgore
faq.answer: High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof rules all tauren lands from Thunder Bluff atop the northern mesas. His son, Baine Bloodhoof, governs Bloodhoof Village and tends to the lower plains' daily concerns under Cairne's wisdom.

angles.text: This valley is your ancestral home, reclaimed through sacrifice and unity. You must preserve its wells and cleanse its sacred grounds in service to the Earthmother.
Mulgore is the heart of Horde spirituality and agriculture in central Kalimdor. A blood oath of mutual defense binds it to Thrall's people.
Mulgore's rolling plains and untouched groves are among Kalimdor's purest natural sanctuaries. Here, tauren druids study balance and nature's gifts.
The Great Hunt thrives across Mulgore's plains, where cougars, wolves, and wild kodo test your skill and patience as a tracker.
